福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・中西區

看西街教會Kansi Street Church

認識馬雅各醫師、全台第一間西式醫館，還有那座仿倫敦聖保羅大教堂的白色圓頂。

Meet Dr. Maxwell, Taiwan's first Western clinic, and the white dome.

市場巷弄的上空浮著一座白色圓頂，它仿的是倫敦的聖保羅大教堂。1865 年，年輕的蘇格蘭醫師馬雅各，在這條街上開了全台第一間西式醫館。為什麼選這裡？五條港是中藥上岸的港口，街上滿是中藥行和病人。然後謠言傳開：洋醫師挖人心肝、取人眼睛。開館二十三天後，他被群眾趕走。但三年後馬雅各回來了。他的醫館發展成新樓醫院，他也培訓本地醫師。教會在 1955 年落成，有六根圓柱和一座大圓頂。一場二十三天的失敗，用一座圓頂來紀念。

Above the market lanes floats a white dome. It was modeled on Saint Paul's Cathedral in London. In 1865, a young Scottish doctor, James Laidlaw Maxwell, opened Taiwan's first Western clinic on this street. Why here? The Five Channels was where Chinese medicine came ashore, so the streets were full of herb shops and patients. Then rumors spread that the foreign doctor took out people's hearts and eyes. After twenty-three days, a mob drove him out. But Maxwell came back three years later. His clinic grew into Sin-Lau Hospital, and he trained local doctors. The church was finished in 1955, with six columns and a great dome. A failure of twenty-three days, remembered by a dome.

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history
  1. 馬雅各的二十三天1865 年，蘇格蘭醫師馬雅各在看西街開設全台第一間西式醫館。In 1865, a Scottish doctor opened Taiwan's first Western clinic on this street.
  2. 他回來了三年後馬雅各重返台南。Three years later, Maxwell returned to Tainan.
  3. 白色圓頂的教堂1951 年起造，1955 年落成，名為「台灣宣教紀念教會」。Built from 1951 and finished in 1955, it is the Mission Memorial Church of Taiwan.

認識景點

About the place

馬雅各的二十三天Maxwell's twenty-three days

馬雅各：年輕的蘇格蘭醫師，中文名馬雅各。 為什麼選這裡：五條港是中藥上岸的港口，街上滿是中藥行和病人。 看西街：屋舍朝西、面向海港，所以叫「看西」。 免費看病：6 月 16 日在租來的民房開始免費為人治病。

James Laidlaw Maxwell: A young Scottish doctor. Why here?: Chinese medicine came ashore here, so the streets were full of patients. Kansi Street: The street that looks west, toward the harbor. Free treatment: On June sixteenth, he began treating the sick for free.

謠言：傳說洋醫師挖人心肝、取人眼睛做藥。 被迫離開：第二十三天群眾包圍醫館；知縣勸他離開，他南下打狗，躲進英國領事館。

rumor: People said the foreign doctor took out hearts and eyes. Forced to leave: After twenty-three days, a mob surrounded the clinic, and he fled to Takao.

他回來了He came back

新樓醫院：他開設更大的醫館，日後發展成新樓醫院，台灣第一個西醫院系譜。 培訓本地醫師：他培訓台灣本地的醫師。 台語羅馬字：協助把台語推上羅馬字印刷。 設教紀念日：1865 年 6 月 16 日被定為台灣基督長老教會的設教紀念日。

Sin-Lau Hospital: His larger clinic grew into today's Sin-Lau Hospital. Training local doctors: He trained local doctors. Romanized Taiwanese: He helped put the Taiwanese language into romanized print. Founding day: June sixteenth, 1865, is the founding date of the Presbyterian Church in Taiwan.

白色圓頂的教堂The white-domed church

圓頂：以倫敦聖保羅大教堂為靈感的白色大圓頂。 六根圓柱：門廊立著六根古典圓柱。 三角山牆：圓柱上方的三角形山牆。 鐘樓：立面旁的鐘樓。

dome: A great dome inspired by Saint Paul's Cathedral. six columns: Six classical columns stand at the front. pediment: A triangular pediment above the columns. bell tower: A bell tower beside the facade.

1917 佈道所：太平境教會 1917 年回到這條街設立佈道所，紀念起點。 中華聖母主教座堂：開山路上的天主堂，有燕尾屋脊和紅色樑柱，聖母住進了中國宮殿。

1917 mission station: In 1917, Taipingjing Church set up a mission station on this street. Our Lady, Queen of China: A Catholic cathedral with swallowtail ridges and red pillars.

實景照片

Photos on site

夜晚的白色圓頂 The dome at night

夜裡燈光照亮白色圓頂，頂端的十字架閃閃發光。這座教堂 1951 年動工、1955 年完工，圓頂仿倫敦的聖保羅大教堂。

At night, the white dome glows and the cross on top shines. The church was built from 1951 to 1955.

大門與石柱 The gate and its sign

門口石柱寫著「南部設教紀念教會」，紀念長老教會在台灣南部開始傳教的地方。正面橫匾寫著「看西街臺灣基督長老教會」，六根圓柱撐起三角山牆。

The gatepost sign says this church remembers where Presbyterian mission work in southern Taiwan began. Six columns hold up the triangular pediment.
